title: Getting started with usefulfunctions
text: volcano_plot() takes differential-expression table log fold change adjusted p-value, colours points cutoffs pass, labels genes.  Highlighting gene interest uses point helpers, return one value per row:
code: set.seed(1) de <- data.frame(   logFC = rnorm(500, sd = 1.2),   FDR = runif(500)^3,   row.names = paste0("gene", 1:500) ) de["NKG7", ] <- c(2.8, 1e-6)  volcano_plot(de, fc_cutoff = 1, label_genes = "NKG7", title = "NK cells versus T cells") volcano_plot(   de,   fc_cutoff = 1,   label_genes = "NKG7",   point_colours = colour_volcano_points(de, highlight.selected = TRUE, highlight.genes = "NKG7",                                         logFC.cutoff = 1),   alpha = alpha_volcano_points(de, "NKG7", baseline.alpha = 0.3),   point_size = size_volcano_points(de, "NKG7", baseline.size = 2, highlight.size = 5) )

title: Getting started with usefulfunctions
text: sc_correlation() correlates one gene every gene across cells reports correlation, p-value Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, sorted least correlated.
code: expr <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 60), nrow = 40,                dimnames = list(c("NKG7", paste0("g", 1:39)), paste0("cell", 1:60))) expr["g1", ] <- expr["NKG7", ] + rnorm(60, sd = 0.3)   # a co-expressed gene  cor_df <- sc_correlation(expr, goi = "NKG7", remove.quantile = 0, output.tables = NULL) head(cor_df, 4) #>   GeneID   Cor.val        P.val          FDR #> 1   NKG7 1.0000000 0.000000e+00 0.000000e+00 #> 2     g1 0.9676582 2.187029e-36 4.374059e-35 #> 3     g5 0.2413651 6.319048e-02 5.089608e-01 #> 4    g35 0.2322416 7.416485e-02 5.089608e-01 plots <- plot_correlation(cor_df, output.dir = NULL, goi = "NKG7", top.n.val = 8) plots$ranking

title: Getting started with usefulfunctions
text: stratify_by_expression() returns samples top bottom quantile gene, multi-gene signature scored mean z-score. stratification step used tcga_survival().
code: bulk <- matrix(rexp(3 * 40), nrow = 3,                dimnames = list(c("NKG7", "GZMB", "ACTB"), paste0("TCGA-AB-", sprintf("%04d", 1:40), "-01A"))) strata <- stratify_by_expression(bulk, c("NKG7", "GZMB"), quantile = 0.25) lengths(strata[c("high", "low")]) #> high  low  #>   10   10

title: Reusable Helpers for Single-Cell, Bulk RNA-Seq and Cancer Genomics
text: R package tested helpers single-cell, bulk RNA-seq cancer-genomics analyses: volcano plots, gene-gene correlation, Gene Ontology -representation, mouse-human ortholog conversion, TCGA overall-survival analysis UMAP parameter sweeps. started shared code behind analysis repositories account kept small, documented covered tests. Documentation: https://eomesodermin.github.io/r-utility-functions/

title: Reusable Helpers for Single-Cell, Bulk RNA-Seq and Cancer Genomics
text: Light install. ggplot2, dplyr small packages required. Seurat, clusterProfiler, biomaRt, TCGAbiolinks heavy dependencies optional; function checks needs called says install. Functions return objects. Plot functions return ggplot objects (paths wrote) rather drawing active device, results can tested reused. Tested. Pure logic (stratification, ortholog lookup, barcode handling, plot construction) unit tested; calls external services isolated can mocked.

title: Volcano plot of differential-expression results — volcano_plot
text: Plots log fold change -log10 adjusted p-value, colouring points whether pass fold-change cutoff, significance cutoff, neither, labelling genes ggrepel (installed).

title: Volcano plot of differential-expression results — volcano_plot
code: volcano_plot(   data,   x = "logFC",   y = "FDR",   labels = rownames(data),   label_genes = NULL,   fc_cutoff = 0.25,   p_cutoff = 0.05,   colours = c("grey30", "forestgreen", "royalblue", "red2"),   point_colours = NULL,   alpha = 0.2,   point_size = 3,   label_size = 3.5,   xlim = NULL,   ylim = NULL,   title = "Volcano plot",   subtitle = NULL,   caption = paste0("total = ", nrow(data), " variables"),   legend_position = "top" )

title: Volcano plot of differential-expression results — volcano_plot
text: data Data frame log fold change adjusted p-value column. x, y Names fold-change adjusted p-value columns. labels Labels points; defaults row names data. label_genes Optional character vector genes label. NULL, points passing cutoffs labelled. fc_cutoff, p_cutoff Absolute log fold change adjusted p-value cutoffs. colours Four colours groups NS, FC, P FC + P, order. point_colours Optional per-point colours, one per row data, whose names give point's legend group (see colour_volcano_points()). Overrides colours. alpha, point_size Point transparency size (single value, one per row; see alpha_volcano_points() size_volcano_points()). label_size Label text size. xlim, ylim Optional axis limits. Defaults extend data range. title, subtitle, caption Plot annotations. caption defaults number points. legend_position Legend position passed ggplot2::theme().

title: usefulfunctions 0.3.0
text: quality release: correctness fixes found much larger test suite, original replacements code derived another package, documentation site.

title: usefulfunctions 0.3.0
text: tcga_survival() now splits patients true upper lower quartiles expression. Previously quartiles rounded floor() / ceiling(), classified nearly every patient “high” genes low expression (TPM 1). Results genes change. sc_correlation() returns genes sorted decreasing correlation (alphabetical), drops genes undefined correlation, always keeps gene interest filtering expression, writes CSV without extra row-name column. output.tables = NULL skips writing. debug.mode ignored. plotting helpers (umap_optimise(), correlation_heatmaps(), plot_correlation(), dendrogram_samples()) longer rely dev.copy() active graphics device. return plots (paths) write PDFs output.dir; NULL skips writing. dot.case names (makeTransparent(), GO.function(), TCGA.OS(), …) now warn per session forwarding snake_case function; see ?legacy_aliases.

title: usefulfunctions 0.3.0
text: volcano_plot(): original, compact volcano plot (ggplot2, optional ggrepel) takes per-point colour, alpha size helpers. custom_enhanced_volcano() now deprecated wrapper. stratify_by_expression(): high / low sample strata gene multi-gene signature (mean z-score). Multi-gene signatures previously implemented tcga_survival(). tcga_survival() returns annotated clinical table invisibly. getting-started vignette pkgdown site. jax.table argument ortholog converters offline use.

title: usefulfunctions 0.3.0
text: convert_human_to_mouse(use.jax = TRUE) converted wrong direction (mouse human). dendrogram_samples() failed current factoextra (k must least 2); now clusters hclust() directly. umap_optimise() plotted Seurat::UMAPPlot(), fails unless Seurat attached. moving_average() failed window longer vector. Deprecated tidyselect usage (.data$col inside select()) clean_volcano_data(). Barcode matching TCGA helpers longer depends stringr, patients samples strata left unlabelled instead silently assigned “Low”.
